translations.web: Your righteousness also, God, reaches to the heavens; you have done great things. God, who is like you?
translations.bsb: Your righteousness reaches to the heavens, O God, You who have done great things. Who, O God, is like You?
translations.kjv: Thy righteousness also, O God, is very high, who hast done great things: O God,
translations.asv: Thy righteousness also, O God, is very high; Thou who hast done great things, O God, who is like unto thee?
